venue.name: Crag X Climbing Centre
venue.description: Crag X Climbing Centre is an indoor rock climbing gym at 769 Pandora Avenue in downtown Victoria with 15 m walls, two bouldering areas, top-rope, lead and auto-belay climbing. It runs booked group and school climbing lessons and recurring club sessions, and rents shoes, harnesses and chalk bags on site.
venue.hours_notes: Monday 12pm-10pm; Tuesday 10am-10pm; Wednesday 12pm-10pm; Thursday 10am-11pm; Friday 10am-11pm; Saturday 8am-8pm; Sunday 10am-6pm. Routesetting happens Mondays and Wednesdays, which is why the gym opens at noon those days. All rates listed are without tax.
venue.seasonal_notes: Sunday hours are listed as closed in July and August. Holiday closures for 2026: closed New Year's Day, Victoria Day, Canada Day, Labour Day, and December 24 and 25.

programs.name: School Groups one-time lesson
programs.description: Two-hour group lesson teaching harness fitting, knots and safely managing the rope belay systems, so participants can climb on their own afterwards. Rental equipment for the lesson is included plus two weeks of free gym entry (gear not included during the two free weeks). $69 per person for groups of 6-12 and $59 per person for groups of 13 or more; rates are per person and taxes are extra. Advance booking required.
programs.evidence: $69 per person for groups of 6-12. $59 per person for 13 or more.

programs.name: School Groups club session
programs.description: Recurring option for school groups: a beginner lesson in the first session plus three or more subsequent climbing sessions at a preset time, so the group can come back and climb together. All gear is included in the lesson and every session. Rates are per person and taxes are extra. Advance booking required. Listed as Ages 12+.
programs.evidence: The cost for this offering is $49 for the lesson and $20 for each climbing session.

programs.name: Group Beginner Lesson
programs.description: A 2.5 hour complete beginner lesson for groups covering how to put on a harness, tie the figure eight knot and belay another climber; on completion the group qualifies for a Crag X Access card and receives one week of free entry to the gym. $45 per climber with a 10 climber minimum (this is a minimum group size, not a maximum). Taxes extra, advanced booking required.

programs.name: Day pass drop-in visit
programs.description: Drop-in climbing without a lesson. Adult day pass $22, student/military $20, and the child policy page states youth rates are the same rate as students/military. Rentals extra: shoes $6, harness $3, chalk bag $3. All rates are without tax. Everyone in the facility must be a qualified belayer or under the supervision of one, so a group without belay-tested adults would need a lesson instead.

gaps: School group programs are listed as Ages 12+, so nothing on the site covers daycare or early-elementary groups; the child policy allows under-12s only with one-to-one supervision by a belay-tested adult and only from opening until 6pm.
No maximum group size or capacity per booking is stated (the 10-climber figure on the Group Lesson page is a minimum, not a maximum).
No minimum lead time or advance-notice window for group bookings is stated, only 'Advanced booking required'.
No washroom, change room or lunch/eating space information anywhere on the site.
No wheelchair or stroller accessibility information.
No bus or vehicle parking information; the location page mentions only bike parking and transit.
No adult supervision ratio required for school groups is stated.
Prices carry no year or season label, so it is unclear which school year they apply to.
